Points 200 +50 with video Build on ai.pharos.xyz What you'll build A natural-language assistant that answers questions about a wallet's positions, balances and yields across multiple protocols, such as "what am I earning?", "where is my USDC?" or "what's my biggest position?". This generalizes Harbor's query pattern. Requirements 01 Reads positions from at least 2 protocols or vaults, plus wallet token balances. 02 Answers at least 5 different natural-language question types correctly. 03 Shows numbers with sources: which contract and block each figure came from. 04 Says clearly when it doesn't know or can't read a protocol, rather than guessing. 05 Read-only: never initiates transactions. Reviewers score against this list. Missing items can mean partial points. What to submit A proof link reviewers can open — a share link from ai.pharos.xyz, a tx hash on the explorer, or a deployed demo. A repo link if you wrote code. Optional: a video walking through the build for +50 points. Submit your build Sign in with GitHub to submit and track your points.
